company.name: Warpfy
company.shortDescription: Warpfy develops an e-commerce technology platform to acquire and manage e-commerce brands.
company.description: Warpfy acquires e-commerce stores in promising categories and scales this multi-channel systematically into global D2C brands. Taking help of big data approach to launch new products, apply techniques in eCommerce, use different technology platforms to grow them multi-channel, and optimize the supply chain for speed to market, and turn these into superbrands that sell products across global marketplaces like Amazon, Shopify, Shopee, and more.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,455,173 to $4,428,620, a 1.8x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 24 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 34 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
